text: ふだんは　とても　おとなしいが　ミツをすうのを　じゃまする　やつは　ツノを　つかって　おいはらう。

structure.jp: ふだんは　とても　おとなしいが
structure.en: it is usually very docile, but

structure.jp: ミツをすうのを　じゃまする　やつは
structure.en: anyone who gets in the way of its sipping sap

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ミツをすうのを　じゃまする　やつ
patterns.explanation: The words before やつ describe which ones are meant. ミツをすうのを　じゃまする　やつ = 'anyone who disturbs its sipping of sap'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing that can be disturbed. ミツをすうの = 'the sipping of sap'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a statement means 'but'. とても　おとなしいが = 'it is very docile, but'.
